_note: SYNTHETIC example company for demonstration. Not a real business.
description: Project-management and reporting software for 10-200 person agencies. Self-serve signup plus a small sales team for larger accounts.
pricing_notes: Flat per-workspace pricing. No usage or seat expansion. About 15% of customers are on annual plans. Frequent 20% discounts to close deals.
qualitative: Support tickets frequently mention surprise charges and failed-card lockouts.
Reviews praise reporting but say onboarding is confusing.
Larger agencies ask for per-seat pricing and client-facing dashboards.
Sales team reports losing deals on missing SSO below the Business tier.
known_constraints: Board wants to see a path to profitability
